subject: GCP Private Offer — drawdown milestone acceptance & billing routing
messages:
From: Julia Kim <julia.kim@cloudwave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: CloudWave / Redwood — proposed commit & drawdown

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the briefing earlier this week. CloudWave is prepared to accept the private offer you shared, pending a short alignment on the drawdown cadence and invoicing. We are targeting a Q3 activation and want a predictable redemption plan to map to our internal quarters.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the initial drawdown schedule (monthly vs. quarterly)?
- Is there flexibility to frontload a portion of the committed credit in month 1?
- Where should invoices be routed for the marketplace redemption?

I can loop in procurement if helpful — Alex (cc'd) handles that.

Appreciate any quick notes so we can get legal and procurement moving.

Best,
Julia
Julia Kim
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudWave Inc.
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Julia Kim <julia.kim@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: CloudWave / Redwood — proposed commit & drawdown

Julia — thanks for the note and for moving quickly. Happy to align.

Quick answers up front:
- We typically model drawdown on a monthly redemption schedule for private offers, but we can structure a quarterly cadence if that matches your finance flows.
- Frontloading is possible — we'll need to see the requested percentage and map it to the SKU entitlement so it doesn't break entitlement accounting in the GCP monthly report.
- Invoices for marketplace redemption are usually routed to the billing contact you provide; our finance team (Ben Carter) will confirm required fields.

Jonas and Marissa are cc'd — Jonas will propose a draft drawdown milestone schedule and Marissa will own co-sell handoffs. If procurement wants to sign a short acceptance now, we can push a DocuSign through with the milestone sheet attached.

I'll wait for Jonas' schedule and Alex/procurement to confirm billing contact.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Strategic Channels
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private Offer: CloudWave / Redwood — proposed commit & drawdown

Priya / Julia / team — attaching a proposed drawdown plan for CloudWave. See attachments: RW_MAP_v1.docx (mutual action plan), gcp-sku-mapping.csv (SKU mapping to the private-offer entitlement), drawdown-proposal.xlsx (monthly phasing).

Summary of the proposal (numbers are % of committed value):
- Month 1 (go-live): 30% (canary + frontload for onboarding)
- Month 2: 25%
- Month 3: 20%
- Month 4+: remaining 25% spread monthly over the next 6 months

Operational notes:
- Canary window: roll to one region (us-central1) for first 72 hours to validate SKU redemption hooks; if successful, full region roll after 72 hours.
- Billing: invoices should point to the GCP Marketplace redemption ID; Ben will provide the routing alias.
- Co-sell: Marissa will coordinate with your AE for the joint launch webinar and customer PR.

Let me know if CloudWave needs the frontload reduced (e.g., 20% instead of 30%) — we can re-run the entitlement mapping quickly.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW_MAP_v1.docx, gcp-sku-mapping.csv, drawdown-proposal.xlsx

- Frontload 25% of committed credit in month 1 (CloudWave needs higher runway for onboarding).
- Month 2 should be 25%; month 3 20%; remainder as proposed.
- Please route invoices to invoices@cloudwave.com; include GCP redemption ID and our PO number when available.

I've attached a signed acceptance PDF for the milestones we discussed (signed-acceptance.pdf). We'll still need a short DocuSign for signature authority on the private-offer ordering doc.

Procurement will confirm PO number by EOD Friday.

Regards,
CloudWave Procurement Team
